% fig32_tileformat_tikz.tex  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
% TikZ/PGF reproduction of the BALS tiled storage format (Fig. 2).
% Formerly generated by generate_figures2.py as fig32_tileformat.pdf.
%
% USAGE in 3_method.tex:
%   \resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{\input{figures/fig32_tileformat_tikz.tex}}
%
% STANDALONE TEST:
%   \documentclass[border=3mm]{standalone}
%   \usepackage{tikz,xcolor,amsmath}
%   \usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,backgrounds,decorations.pathreplacing}
%   \begin{document}\input{figures/fig32_tileformat_tikz.tex}\end{document}
%
% Required in main.tex preamble (already added):
%   \usepackage{tikz,xcolor}
%   \usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,backgrounds,decorations.pathreplacing,
%                   shapes.geometric,fit,positioning}
% ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

% ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\colorlet{figInk}{black!93}
\colorlet{figInk2}{black!60}
\definecolor{figBlue}{HTML}{2a78d6}
\definecolor{figAqua}{HTML}{1baf7a}
\definecolor{figYellow}{HTML}{eda100}
\definecolor{figOrange}{HTML}{eb6834}
\definecolor{figGrid}{HTML}{e8e7e3}
\definecolor{tBlue}{HTML}{e7f0fb}
\definecolor{tAqua}{HTML}{e4f6ef}
\definecolor{tYellow}{HTML}{fdf3dd}
\definecolor{tGray}{HTML}{f2f1ee}
\definecolor{emptyTile}{HTML}{eceae6}
\definecolor{cellborder}{HTML}{c9c7c2}

% All lengths in mm; use explicit coordinates throughout (no pgfmathsetmacro mm).
% Grid: 8 cols × 5 rows.  Tile: 8 mm wide × 5.5 mm tall.
% Origin (0,0) = bottom-left of the tile grid.
% Visual row 0 = TOP row (highest-frequency users).  Row r → y = (4-r)*5.5 mm.

\begin{tikzpicture}[
  font=\small,
  >=Stealth,
  line cap=round,
  line join=round,
  x=1mm, y=1mm,          % 1 unit = 1 mm
]

% ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
%  Tile grid dimensions (all in mm)
%    TW = 8,  TH = 5.5
%    NR = 5,  NC = 8
%    Grid: 64 wide × 27.5 tall
% ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

% Styles
\tikzset{
  etile/.style={draw=figGrid,   fill=emptyTile, line width=0.5pt, rounded corners=0.5pt},
  stile/.style={draw=cellborder,fill=white,     line width=0.5pt, rounded corners=0.5pt},
  btile/.style={draw=cellborder,fill=tBlue,     line width=0.5pt, rounded corners=0.5pt},
}

% ── Draw all 40 tiles ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
% Tile at col c (0-based), visual row vr (0=top):
%   x0 = c*8,  y0 = (4-vr)*5.5
% Each tile is 8×5.5.

% vr=0 (top, densest)
\foreach \c/\sty in {0/btile,1/btile,2/btile,3/btile,4/stile,5/stile,6/etile,7/etile}{
  \draw[\sty] (\c*8, 22) rectangle (\c*8+8, 27.5);
}
% vr=1
\foreach \c/\sty in {0/btile,1/btile,2/btile,3/stile,4/stile,5/etile,6/etile,7/etile}{
  \draw[\sty] (\c*8, 16.5) rectangle (\c*8+8, 22);
}
% vr=2
\foreach \c/\sty in {0/btile,1/stile,2/stile,3/stile,4/etile,5/etile,6/etile,7/etile}{
  \draw[\sty] (\c*8, 11) rectangle (\c*8+8, 16.5);
}
% vr=3
\foreach \c/\sty in {0/stile,1/stile,2/etile,3/etile,4/etile,5/etile,6/etile,7/etile}{
  \draw[\sty] (\c*8, 5.5) rectangle (\c*8+8, 11);
}
% vr=4 (bottom, sparsest)
\foreach \c/\sty in {0/stile,1/etile,2/etile,3/etile,4/etile,5/etile,6/etile,7/etile}{
  \draw[\sty] (\c*8, 0) rectangle (\c*8+8, 5.5);
}

% ── Rating dots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
% Dense (btile) cells get ~8-11 dots; sparse (stile) get 3-5.

% vr=0, col 0  (btile, y 22..27.5)
\foreach \px/\py in {1.1/25.8,2.4/24.3,3.8/26.5,5.1/23.8,6.4/26.0,
                      1.7/23.5,4.5/25.2,6.8/24.5,2.9/26.8,5.7/25.6,3.3/24.0}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=0, col 1  (btile, y 22..27.5)
\foreach \px/\py in {8.8/25.8,10.1/24.3,11.5/26.5,12.8/23.8,14.1/26.0,
                      9.4/23.5,12.2/25.2,14.5/24.5,9.8/26.8,13.4/25.6}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=0, col 2  (btile)
\foreach \px/\py in {16.8/25.8,18.1/24.3,19.5/26.5,20.8/23.8,22.1/26.0,
                      17.4/23.5,20.2/25.2,22.5/24.5,17.8/26.8,21.4/25.6}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=0, col 3  (btile)
\foreach \px/\py in {24.8/25.8,26.1/24.3,27.5/26.5,28.8/23.8,30.1/26.0,
                      25.4/23.5,28.2/25.2,30.5/24.5,25.8/26.8}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=0, col 4  (stile, fewer)
\foreach \px/\py in {32.8/25.5,34.5/24.6,36.8/26.0,33.5/23.8,35.8/25.2}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=0, col 5  (stile)
\foreach \px/\py in {40.8/25.3,42.5/24.4,44.8/25.8,41.5/23.9}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=1, col 0  (btile, y 16.5..22)
\foreach \px/\py in {1.1/20.3,2.4/18.8,3.8/21.0,5.1/18.3,6.4/20.5,
                      1.7/18.0,4.5/19.7,6.8/19.0,2.9/21.3,5.7/20.1}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=1, col 1  (btile)
\foreach \px/\py in {8.8/20.3,10.1/18.8,11.5/21.0,12.8/18.3,14.1/20.5,
                      9.4/18.0,12.2/19.7,14.5/19.0,9.8/21.3}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=1, col 2  (btile — this is the HIGHLIGHTED tile)
\foreach \px/\py in {16.8/20.3,18.1/18.8,19.5/21.0,20.8/18.3,22.1/20.5,
                      17.4/18.0,20.2/19.7,22.5/19.0,17.8/21.3}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=1, col 3  (stile)
\foreach \px/\py in {24.8/20.0,26.1/18.8,27.5/21.0,28.8/18.3,30.1/20.5}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=1, col 4  (stile)
\foreach \px/\py in {32.8/20.0,34.5/19.1,36.8/20.5}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=2, col 0  (btile, y 11..16.5)
\foreach \px/\py in {1.1/14.8,2.4/13.3,3.8/15.5,5.1/12.8,6.4/15.0,
                      1.7/12.5,4.5/14.2,6.8/13.5,2.9/15.8}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=2, col 1  (stile)
\foreach \px/\py in {8.8/14.8,10.1/13.3,11.5/15.5,12.8/12.8,14.1/15.0}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=2, col 2  (stile)
\foreach \px/\py in {16.8/14.5,18.1/13.1,19.5/15.3,20.8/12.8}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=2, col 3  (stile)
\foreach \px/\py in {24.8/14.5,26.1/13.1,27.5/15.3,28.8/12.8}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=3, col 0  (stile, y 5.5..11)
\foreach \px/\py in {1.1/9.3,2.4/7.8,3.8/10.0,5.1/7.3,6.4/9.5}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=3, col 1  (stile)
\foreach \px/\py in {8.8/9.3,10.1/7.8,11.5/10.0,12.8/7.3}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}
% vr=4, col 0  (stile, y 0..5.5)
\foreach \px/\py in {1.1/3.8,2.4/2.3,3.8/4.5,5.1/1.8,6.4/4.0}{
  \fill[figBlue] (\px,\py) circle[radius=0.45pt];
}

% ── Highlight box: vr=1, col=2 → x:[16,24], y:[16.5,22] ─────────────────────
\draw[draw=figOrange, line width=1.5pt, rounded corners=0.5pt]
  (16, 16.5) rectangle (24, 22);

% Dashed leaders to expanded tile below
\draw[figOrange, line width=0.7pt, dashed] (16, 16.5) -- (-1, -7);
\draw[figOrange, line width=0.7pt, dashed] (24, 16.5) -- (65, -7);

% ── Axis arrows ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\draw[->, draw=figInk2, line width=0.8pt] (-6, 27.5) -- (-6, 0);
\node[rotate=90, anchor=south, font=\footnotesize, text=figInk2]
  at (-6, 13.75) {users (frequency-sorted)};

\draw[->, draw=figInk2, line width=0.8pt] (0, -2.5) -- (64, -2.5);
\node[anchor=north, font=\footnotesize, text=figInk2]
  at (22, -3) {items (frequency-sorted)};
\node[anchor=north, font=\scriptsize\itshape, text=figInk2]
  at (49, -3) {(gray = empty tiles, excluded)};

% ── Grid title ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\node[font=\footnotesize, text=figInk2, align=center]
  at (32, 31)
  {Training matrix $R$ — $XB{\times}YB$ tiles
   ($32{\times}256$;\ $YB{=}128$ for $K{>}32$)};

% ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
%  BOTTOM — Expanded tile
%  Origin: outer box top = y=-9, bottom = y=-75  (66 mm tall)
%          x from -1 to 65  (66 mm wide)
% ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\draw[draw=figOrange, fill=figOrange!5, rounded corners=3pt, line width=1pt]
  (-1, -75) rectangle (65, -9);

\node[font=\footnotesize\bfseries, text=figOrange, anchor=north west, inner sep=2pt]
  at (-1, -9) {Expanded tile $t$\ (32 rows $\times$ 256 columns)};

% ── tile_colidx[] ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
% Label at y=-17
\node[font=\footnotesize\bfseries, text=figInk, anchor=west]
  at (0, -17) {\texttt{tile\_colidx[~]}};

% Cells: 8 cells × 6.5 wide × 4.5 tall, bottom at y=-26.5, top at y=-22
% cell i → x0 = i*6.5, x1 = (i+1)*6.5
\foreach \i/\val in {0/3,1/17,2/42,3/88,4/131,5/202,6/245}{
  \draw[draw=figBlue, fill=tBlue, rounded corners=0.5pt, line width=0.7pt]
    (\i*6.5, -26.5) rectangle (\i*6.5+6.5, -22);
  \node[font=\scriptsize] at (\i*6.5+3.25, -24.25) {\val};
}
% Ellipsis cell
\draw[draw=figBlue, fill=tBlue, rounded corners=0.5pt, line width=0.7pt]
  (45.5, -26.5) rectangle (52, -22);
\node[font=\scriptsize] at (48.75, -24.25) {$\ldots$};

% Right annotation
\node[font=\scriptsize\itshape, text=figInk2, anchor=west, align=left, text width=12mm]
  at (53, -24.25)
  {distinct cols\\in $t$ $\to$\\stage rows\\once; reused\\by all 32 rows};

% ── Per-row segments box ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
% Box: top y=-30, bottom y=-62
\draw[draw=figBlue, fill=figBlue!7, rounded corners=2.5pt, line width=0.8pt]
  (-0.5, -62) rectangle (64, -30);

\node[font=\footnotesize\bfseries, text=figBlue, anchor=north west, inner sep=2pt]
  at (-0.5, -30) {per-row segments (local to the tile)};

% Three rows of arrays
% Row 0 (seg_ptr): label top at y=-34, cells top at y=-37.5
% Row 1 (seg_colidx): label at -43.5, cells top -47
% Row 2 (seg_values): label at -53, cells top -56.5

% ---- seg_ptr[] ---------------------------------------------------------------
\node[font=\scriptsize\bfseries, text=figInk, anchor=west]  at (0,-34) {\texttt{seg\_ptr[~]}};
\node[font=\scriptsize\itshape,  text=figInk2, anchor=west] at (0,-37) {row-start offsets};
\foreach \i/\val in {0/0,1/2,2/5,3/5,4/9,5/{$\ldots$}}{
  \draw[draw=figInk2, fill=tGray, rounded corners=0.5pt, line width=0.6pt]
    (22+\i*6.5, -41.5) rectangle (22+\i*6.5+6.5, -37);
  \node[font=\scriptsize] at (22+\i*6.5+3.25, -39.25) {\val};
}

% ---- seg_colidx[] ------------------------------------------------------------
\node[font=\scriptsize\bfseries, text=figInk, anchor=west]  at (0,-43.5) {\texttt{seg\_colidx[~]}};
\node[font=\scriptsize\itshape,  text=figInk2, anchor=west] at (0,-46.5) {local column ids};
\foreach \i/\val in {0/1,1/4,2/0,3/3,4/5,5/{$\ldots$}}{
  \draw[draw=figAqua, fill=tAqua, rounded corners=0.5pt, line width=0.6pt]
    (22+\i*6.5, -51) rectangle (22+\i*6.5+6.5, -46.5);
  \node[font=\scriptsize] at (22+\i*6.5+3.25, -48.75) {\val};
}

% ---- seg_values[] ------------------------------------------------------------
\node[font=\scriptsize\bfseries, text=figInk, anchor=west]  at (0,-53) {\texttt{seg\_values[~]}};
\node[font=\scriptsize\itshape,  text=figInk2, anchor=west] at (0,-56) {rating values};
\foreach \i/\val in {0/{4.0},1/{3.5},2/{5.0},3/{2.0},4/{4.5},5/{$\ldots$}}{
  \draw[draw=figAqua, fill=tAqua, rounded corners=0.5pt, line width=0.6pt]
    (22+\i*6.5, -60.5) rectangle (22+\i*6.5+6.5, -56);
  \node[font=\scriptsize] at (22+\i*6.5+3.25, -58.25) {\val};
}

% ── Density formula box ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
% Bottom box: top y=-64, bottom y=-74
\draw[draw=figYellow, fill=tYellow, rounded corners=2pt, line width=0.8pt]
  (-0.5, -74) rectangle (39, -64);
\node[font=\small, align=center, text width=36mm]
  at (19.25, -69)
  {$d_t = \dfrac{\mathrm{nnz}(t)}{XB \cdot YB}$ — drives FP16/FP32\\[2pt]
   staging choice ($d_t \geq \tau_1 = 10^{-3}$)};

% ── Compacted tile list box ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
\draw[draw=figInk2, fill=tGray, rounded corners=2pt, line width=0.8pt]
  (41, -74) rectangle (64, -64);
\node[font=\small, align=center, text width=20mm]
  at (52.5, -69)
  {compacted active-tile list\\[1pt]($\approx$30\% empty tiles removed)};

\end{tikzpicture}
